integrity: All algebraic identities and finite-field certificates used in the proof are exact and replayable from the embedded verifier. No independent audit or validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The proof resolves only d=8; the exceptional d=24 and d=48 cases remain outside the claim.
The result supplies one exact term of the infinite density constant and does not evaluate the full constant in closed form.
The finite verifier checks algebraic certificates and counting; the infinite density statement additionally uses Frobenius--Chebotarev.
title: The first exceptional harmonic-denominator density: \(\delta(f_8)=25/64\)
